title: Apple removes anti-malware apps for harvesting browser data
text:
Apple removes anti-malware apps for harvesting browser data
Apps from a well-known cyber-security firm were taken down from the Mac app store by Apple after they were found to export users' browser histories. Several anti-malware apps made by Trend Micro have since been updated by the cyber-security company. However, Trend Micro strongly denied allegations that the apps had been "stealing user data" and sending it to a server in China. The apps' behaviour was noticed by a security researcher last week.
